settings.heading: Your first box, sent express
settings.text: Join the list and we will upgrade your first box to express delivery, on us. We write once a month at most, usually when something has changed on the bench.
settings.fine_print: One email a month at most. Leave any time, in one click.
settings.done_text: There is a note on its way to you with the upgrade on it. If it has not landed in ten minutes, have a look in your promotions tab.
settings.image_alt: The Signature Sleep Box tied with a ribbon, seen from above

settings.heading: We will remind you a week before
settings.text: Tell us the date and we will send one note seven days out, which is enough time to have a box arrive on the morning rather than the week after.
settings.fine_print: One reminder a year. Nothing else uses the date.
settings.step_two_text: Saved against your profile so we can send a single note, once a year. You can change it by replying to any email from us.
settings.done_text: Seven days before, one email, and nothing else between now and then.

settings.heading: The cut-off is later than you think
settings.text: Order before the cut-off on a business day and your box is packed and sent that afternoon. If you would rather sit on it, we can send your cart to your inbox instead.
settings.done_text: It is in your inbox and it will keep. Come back to it whenever suits.
